nodes.verdict_basis: hold_case_count is judged by birdsql:1164's own official gold SQL rerun LIVE on the bird_thrombosis_prediction_-prefixed book — a true single-row COUNT scalar; the spine root, scaled downstream off a declared per-contract multiplier into the hold arithmetic

source_recipe.executed_sql: SELECT  COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_thrombosis_prediction_Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) = '1997' AND T2.Thrombosis = 1

nodes.verdict_basis: overlimit_index is judged by birdsql:1039's own official gold SQL rerun LIVE on the bird_european_football_2_-prefixed book — a true single-row REAL scalar stored verbatim; the cross-book input woven into the hold arithmetic

source_recipe.executed_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(t2.long_shots) AS REAL) / COUNT(t2.long_shots) FROM bird_european_football_2_Player AS t1 INNER JOIN bird_european_football_2_Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag'

nodes.rule: overlimit_uplift = round(overlimit_index) * 1000; hold_carry = auto_release_base + overlimit_uplift; hold_delta = overlimit_uplift; branch = 'EXTENDED_REVIEW' if delta>=1000000, 'PARTIAL_HOLD' if delta>=1000, else 'AUTO_RELEASE'
nodes.follows: value-rounded + scaled + additive combine + threshold-to-categorical CASE; the 1000/1000000 bands are declared constants; the branch predicate is source-expressed (delta from the live european_football_2 book)

nodes.rule: depositor-contact beat == the source task's own three checks across two gyms, gated on the n12 tier relay
inputs: tier relay <- n12 CRM [MDH-TIER] (must equal the live re-derivation)

inputs: gate <- n13 CSM case + gym-calendar session (register-state gate)
